```{r}
#| include: false
# Objects saved by the Technical Report (Take-home_Ex02.qmd) are reused here,
# so that the slides render quickly. Render the Technical Report first.
pacman::p_load(sf, sfdep, tmap, tidyverse, knitr)

mmr_conflict <- read_rds("data/rds/mmr_conflict.rds")
acled_df <- read_rds("data/rds/acled_df.rds")
lisa <- read_rds("data/rds/lisa.rds")
HCSA <- read_rds("data/rds/HCSA.rds")
mmr_ehsa <- read_rds("data/rds/mmr_ehsa.rds")
ehsa_battles <- read_rds("data/rds/ehsa_battles.rds")
ehsa_explosions <- read_rds("data/rds/ehsa_explosions.rds")
ehsa_pal <- read_rds("data/rds/ehsa_pal.rds")

mmr_ts <- mmr_conflict %>%
  select(ST, TS, TS_PCODE)

quarters <- tibble(quarter_id = 1:19) %>%
  mutate(quarter = paste0(2021 + (quarter_id - 1) %/% 4,
                          " Q", (quarter_id - 1) %% 4 + 1))

sig_classes <- function(ehsa_map) {
  ehsa_map %>%
    filter(classification != "no pattern detected") %>%
    mutate(classification = factor(
      classification,
      levels = intersect(names(ehsa_pal), unique(classification))))
}

map_ehsa <- function(ehsa_map, title) {
  ehsa_map_sig <- sig_classes(ehsa_map)
  tm_shape(ehsa_map) +
    tm_polygons(fill = "grey95", col = "grey70") +
  tm_shape(ehsa_map_sig) +
    tm_polygons(fill = "classification",
                fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(
                  values = unname(ehsa_pal[levels(ehsa_map_sig$classification)])),
                fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "EHSA class")) +
    tm_title(title)
}

n_events <- format(nrow(acled_df), big.mark = ",")
n_fatal <- format(sum(acled_df$fatalities), big.mark = ",")
n_active <- sum(mmr_conflict$events > 0)
n_hh <- sum(lisa$LISA_cluster == "High-High")
n_hot <- sum(HCSA$HCSA_cluster == "Hot spot")
n_ehsa_sig <- sum(mmr_ehsa$classification != "no pattern detected")
```

## 1. Why this matters

::: {.stats}
::: {.stat}
[`r n_events`]{.num} [armed conflict events, Jan 2021 to Sep 2025]{.label}
:::

::: {.stat}
[`r n_fatal`]{.num} [reported fatalities]{.label}
:::

::: {.stat}
[`r n_active` / 330]{.num} [townships with at least one event]{.label}
:::
:::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.card}
[The problem]{.eyebrow}

Since the February 2021 coup, armed conflict has spread across Myanmar. Humanitarian and peace actors need to know **where** violence concentrates and **where it is getting worse**, to prioritise protection and aid.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="52%"}
::: {.card}
[Research questions]{.eyebrow}

1.  **Where** does armed conflict cluster, and which townships are outliers? (LISA, Gi\*)
2.  **How** are hot spots changing over time: new, intensifying, persistent or diminishing? (EHSA)
:::
:::
::::

## 2. Data and preparation

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.card}
[Data]{.eyebrow}

| Dataset | Source |
|----|----|
| Conflict events, 2021-2025 | ACLED |
| Township boundaries v9.4 (330) | MIMU |
| Population 2023 | HDX (UNFPA, DOP, MIMU) |
:::

::: {.takeaway}
**Armed conflict event:** one ACLED event of type Battles, Explosions/Remote violence, or Violence against civilians
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.card}
[Clearing the land mines]{.eyebrow}

-   Protests, riots and strategic developments **excluded**
-   Events located only to a region (`geo_precision` 3) **removed**
-   ACLED and MIMU **names differ** → join by coordinates, not names
-   Points just off the coast/border **snapped** (≤ 2 km); Bay of Bengal centroids removed
-   Townships with no events **kept as 0**
-   3 **island townships** have no contiguity neighbours → kNN weights
:::
:::
::::

## 3. Analytical approach

::: {.card}
| Question | Method | Settings |
|----|----|----|
| **Where?** clusters and outliers | Local Moran's I (LISA) | kNN (k = 5), row-standardised, 999 permutations, median quadrants |
| **Where?** hot and cold spots | Getis-Ord Gi\* | kNN + self, inverse distance, 999 permutations |
| **How is it changing?** | Emerging Hot Spot Analysis | 19 quarters, time lag 1, Mann-Kendall trend test, 99 permutations |
| **Value-added** | EHSA by event type | Battles vs Explosions/Remote violence |
:::

::: {.takeaway}
All maps show only results significant at **p < 0.05**.
:::

## 10. Limitations and implications

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.card}
[Limitations]{.eyebrow}

-   ACLED relies on media and local partners: **information blackouts** may hide violence, so cold spots may partly be missing reports
-   Event counts do not measure **intensity**; fatalities are often estimated
-   Townships differ greatly in size (**MAUP**)
-   Results depend on the **k = 5 neighbourhood** and quarterly time slices
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.card}
[Implications for peace and humanitarian action]{.eyebrow}

✏️ *Fill in after rendering, e.g.:*

-   *Intensifying/new hot spots → early warning and pre-positioning of aid*
-   *Persistent hot spots → long-term protection and displacement support*
-   *Diminishing hot spots → windows for recovery and local peacebuilding*
:::
:::
